kine01.title: I left them. Why do I miss them?
kine01.caption:
You ended it and you still miss them. Both can be true.
Missing someone isn't a sign you were wrong. Let the feeling pass like weather, and leave the text unsent.

kine02.title: Rereading old texts at 2 a.m.
kine02.caption:
2 a.m., scrolling back two years in one thread. We've all been there.
Late-night brains go looking for closure. Phone in another room, thoughts in a note. It'll all still be there at noon.

kine03.title: Great date. Zero spark.
kine03.caption:
They were kind, funny and on time, and you felt nothing. That's not you being broken.
Sparks can be slow. If you're curious, go again. If not, a kind no is a gift too.

kine04.title: I rehearse texts like a speech
kine04.caption:
Draft eleven of a two-word text? That's just caring how you land.
Pick the version that sounds like you, and send it. The right person will hear you in it.

kine05.title: My best friend got a partner
kine05.caption:
Happy for your best friend and a little lonely at the same time? Completely human.
Say "I miss you" out loud and put a standing friend night on the calendar.

kine06.title: I actually like being single
kine06.caption:
The whole bed, the whole pizza, the whole evening, and you love it. Nothing's wrong with that.
Liking your own company is a skill. A full life isn't a waiting room.
